name: shape.ai
description: An infinite scene workspace that agents can review and extend through MCP.

scripts.build: npm run scene:wasm:build && npm run renderer:wasm:build && vite build
scripts.renderer:wasm:build: scripts/renderer-toolchain.sh wasm-pack build crates/renderer-wgpu --target web --out-dir ../../platforms/web/bridge/wasm --out-name shape_canvas_core
scripts.scene:wasm:build: scripts/renderer-toolchain.sh wasm-pack build crates/scene-core --target web --out-dir ../../platforms/web/bridge/wasm --out-name shape_scene_core --features wasm
